newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay building fire under control-official says.
newsitem.headline: Bombay building fire under control-official says.

text.p: A fire at a 25-storey building in India's financial capital Bombay has been brought under control and there are no reported casualties, a senior government official said on Wednesday.
"The fire is under control," Shridhar Joshi, additional municipal commissioner told Reuters. "Twenty-one people have been rescued."
He said the fire started on the 21st floor.
The building, in the posh Nariman Point business district, is owned by the Express newspaper group and in addition to the newspaper offices, houses offices of local and foreign firms and banks.
